title: Design System: 电气仪控实训室

headline.purpose: Live training state and section titles.

motion.name: field-and-button
motion.purpose: Field border and primary button state changes.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: The single high-priority action for entry and check-in confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 54px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--blue, #0b6cf4); color: #fff; font: 800 16px 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 9px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.18); transition: background .18s ease, transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-deep, #0755c6); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 13px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.22); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(11,108,244,.28); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Identity Field
components.description: Member selection and PIN entry use one quiet, tactile field treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 9px; color: var(--ink, #10213f); font: 700 14px 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 14px 15px; border: 1px solid #cfdaea; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #10213f); font: 400 14px 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; transition: border-color .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #93bdf7; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(11,108,244,.28); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Training Status Hero
components.description: The primary dashboard surface joins live state, duration, and next action.
components.html: ● 实训中02:36:18本次实训时长
components.css: .ds-hero { display: grid; gap: 18px; padding: 28px; border-radius: 18px; background: #0d68e7; color: #fff; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 20px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.2); } .ds-hero strong { font-size: 44px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.055em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-badge { width: fit-content; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 99px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.14); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; }

components.name: Reporting Card
components.description: White card for progress, history, and compact reporting blocks.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 18px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #10213f); font: 700 14px 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.11); } .ds-card strong { color: #075dcb; font-size: 21px; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-card div { height: 10px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 99px; background: #e7eef7; } .ds-card i { display: block; width: 85%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--blue, #0b6cf4); }

components.name: Training Record Item
components.description: Compact, divisible history row with date, time, verification status, and media cue.
components.css: .ds-record { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42px 1fr auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center; padding: 19px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e4eaf3); color: var(--ink, #10213f); font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-record b { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 11px; background: #eef5ff; color: #1266cd; font-size: 13px; text-align: center; } .ds-record span { display: grid; gap: 5px; font-size: 15px; } .ds-record small { color: var(--muted, #5d6f8d); font-size: 13px; } .ds-record em { padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: #e9f8ef; color: #248b5a; font-size: 12px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 800; }

components.name: Photo Check-in Sheet
components.description: Mobile bottom sheet for the required on-site photo evidence.
components.html: 开始实训
components.css: .ds-sheet { display: grid; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 22px 30px; border-radius: 24px 24px 0 0; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #10213f); font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 -18px 52px rgba(0,0,0,.22); } .ds-sheet > i { width: 42px; height: 4px; margin: 0 auto 8px; border-radius: 9px; background: #d5dfec; } .ds-sheet > b { font-size: 25px; } .ds-sheet label { min-height: 140px; display: grid; place-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 16px; border: 1.5px dashed #9bc3fa; border-radius: 15px; background: #f6faff; color: #1a5fac; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sheet label:hover { border-color: var(--blue, #0b6cf4); background: #edf6ff; } .ds-sheet label small { color: #566f94; } .ds-sheet button { min-height: 54px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--blue, #0b6cf4); color: #fff; font: 800 16px 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sheet button:hover { background: var(--blue-deep, #0755c6); } .ds-sheet button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(11,108,244,.28); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: This is an operational, mobile-first interface for recording real training time and on-site photo evidence. It uses a pale gray work canvas, navy identity moments, and electric blue task surfaces to make current status and the next check-in action immediately scannable. Information is deliberately compact: a live training card leads the dashboard, while progress, statistics, and historical records use quiet white containers. Status is expressed with text plus restrained green, orange, or red accents.
keyCharacteristics: Mobile check-in action remains clear and thumb-reachable.
Dense, data-led cards use white surfaces and measured shadows.
Navy frames identity; electric blue identifies active training and primary actions.

rules.name: The Status-in-Words Rule
rules.body: Green, orange, and red support explicit state labels; color never carries the status alone.

rules.name: The Numbers-Align Rule
rules.body: Duration values use tabular numerals and stay visually distinct from descriptive copy.

dos: Do lead the member dashboard with the active training state and one clear action.
Do use white cards on the pale canvas for progress, statistics, and history.
Do pair every success, warning, or error color with readable status text.
Do preserve the bottom-sheet photo capture flow for mobile check-in.
donts: Don't use electric blue as a general decorative fill; reserve it for action, active progress, and live training.
Don't replace the photo requirement with a color-only or icon-only state.
Don't introduce heavy borders or dense navigation that competes with training status.
